messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Cyclobenzaprine is a prescription muscle relaxant.
It is used short-term to relieve muscle spasms.
The spasms are caused by sprains, strains, and injuries.
These include low back and neck pain.
It is used together with rest and physical therapy.
This combination helps relieve pain, tenderness, and limited movement.
These symptoms are caused by muscle spasm.
1,2
Cyclobenzaprine is used to treat fibromyalgia in adults.
It can help reduce pain.
For fibromyalgia, it is taken as a sublingual (under the tongue) tablet at bedtime under the brand name Tonmya.
In clinical trials, Tonmya significantly reduced fibromyalgia pain compared with placebo over 14 weeks.
Close to half of treated patients achieved at least a 30% improvement in pain.
3
The Flexeril brand has been discontinued.
Cyclobenzaprine is available as generic tablets.
Cyclobenzaprine is also available as the brand-name products Amrix and Fexmid.
2,4
Triplet: ["Tonmya", "has clinical trial result", "significantly reduced fibromyalgia pain compared with placebo over 14 weeks"]

The relation 'has clinical trial result' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has demonstrated the clinical outcome or result specified by the object entity in trials.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has benefit': The subject drug has the benefit or therapeutic effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'causes': The subject drug leads to or results in the effect or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has mechanism of action': The subject drug produces its therapeutic effect through the biological mechanism specified by the object entity.
E. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
